note: Real mission. GET (Ground Elapsed Time) is hours:minutes since liftoff, the actual NASA convention used throughout the Apollo program.
facts: Fourth crewed Moon landing; first of the 3 extended-duration "J-missions".
First mission to carry the Lunar Roving Vehicle — 27.9 km (17.3 mi) driven across 3 EVAs.
Landing site: Hadley-Apennine, at the edge of the Apennine mountain front beside Hadley Rille.
12 days, 7 hours, 11 minutes, 53 seconds — the longest Apollo mission flown.
One of the mission's 3 main parachutes only partially inflated at splashdown; the Command Module landed safely on the remaining two.
sources: Wikipedia, "Apollo 15" (infobox facts cross-checked against NASA sources)
